criterion: 更新成功呈現完整一致版本；寫入／生成失敗、中斷或基準競爭時保留資料與進度，未完成集合不冒充有效版本；恢復不覆寫後來修改。
method: Source/contract review and actual executable host regressions
finding: Fault tests cover partial writes, actual effects before progress recording, restart, competing hashes, immutable history and bounded attempts. Effective status requires whole-result validation; parent/audit-child linkage resumes both transitions through the original entry.
